title: Automate KMS/HSM + TLS rotation for Private Installer (Helm / Terraform / Vault / SealedSecrets)
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: automate end-to-end key and certificate rotation workflows for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) to reduce operational toil and eliminate manual HSM/KMS/TLS steps during certificate expiry and key rollovers. This PR adds orchestration across three surfaces: the private-installer Helm charts, Terraform modules for cloud KMS bindings, and operator tooling that drives Vault and SealedSecrets rotations.

Summary: Implemented automated rotation controller and upgrade hooks + Terraform wrappers that can provision KMS keys and HSM bindings and attach them to the installer; added Helm post-upgrade hooks to run Vault rewrap and SealedSecrets re-encryption; introduced a new 'rotation' subcommand in the private-installer CLI for orchestrated rollouts and safe rollback.

What changed (high level):
- New controller: pkg/rotation/controller.go — Watches Certificate/Secret CRs and triggers staged rotation with safety gates and health checks.
- Helm charts: charts/private-installer/templates/rotation-job.yaml (post-upgrade job), charts/private-installer/values.rotation.yaml (config for rotation windows, batch sizes).
- Terraform: modules/kms/* — wrappers for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure KeyVault integration; added optional HSM binding module for on-prem HSMs.
- Vault integration: contrib/vault/rotate.sh and k8s-vault-policy updates; operator calls Vault rewrap API and updates SealedSecrets.
- SealedSecrets re-encryption: operator leverages kubeseal controller to rotate sealed secret payloads without requiring plaintext presence.
- Installer CLI: private-installer rotation plan + apply + rollback commands, with dry-run mode and preflight checks.
- Tests: unit tests for controller logic, integration test harness in perf-canary that simulates cert expiry and key rotation, and end-to-end smoke tests for Helm/Terraform happy path.

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform modules for KMS/HSM provisioning and policy attachments
- [x] Helm hooks + templates for rotation jobs
- [x] Rotation controller with canary/circuit breaker semantics
- [x] Vault and SealedSecrets automation scripts
- [x] Installer CLI integration and upgrade hooks
- [x] Unit and integration tests + CI pipeline updates
- [x] Documentation and release notes snippet

Testing performed: ran CI (unit + lint + e2e). Local integration testing in a VPC testbed: provisioned KMS key, bound to installer, performed dry-run rotation, then apply rotation in 3 batches with automated health checks; validated rolling restart semantics and that traffic rollback occurred on simulated failure. E2E recorded no plaintext leakage — sealed secrets re-encrypted successfully and Vault rewrap returned expected ciphertext version.

Upgrade notes: This change adds a new optional 'rotation' section to values.yaml. Existing installs will be unaffected by default (rotation.enabled: false). Enabling rotation requires providing a policy-bound KMS key or HSM binding and Vault credentials. The Terraform wrappers can create these resources if the operator has sufficient permissions.

Rollback notes: installer CLI supports rotation rollback which re-applies previous certificate/key references. The Helm post-upgrade hooks are guarded with preflight checks; on failure, the release is rolled back and the controller will unstage rotations.

Security considerations: all rotations are performed without exporting plaintext keys; Vault rewrap API used where possible. SealedSecrets are updated using controller credentials and with audit logging enabled. HSM integrations use PKCS#11 providers and do not export private material.

Release notes: Adds automated KMS/HSM + TLS rotation support for Private Installer (Helm/Terraform/Vault/SealedSecrets). Requires opt-in via values.rotation.enabled and optional Terraform module usage for automated key provisioning.

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Can we add a safety gate to prevent rotations during high CPU usage? (commented on pkg/rotation/controller.go). Response: added node-level CPU window check and circuit breaker, plus a flag rotation.pause-on-high-cpu = true.
Priya Singh: Request change: add explicit audit log entries for key rewrap events. Response: wired in structured audit events to the operator and added to contrib/vault/rotate.sh.
Liam O'Connor: Verified Terraform outputs and IAM bindings; suggested clearer docs for role permissions. Response: expanded examples and added a permissions matrix in docs/operations/rotation.md.
QA Bot: e2e flaky on first run (timing). Action: increased test timeouts and added deterministic wait-for conditions. Rerun CI showed green.
release_notes: Adds opt-in automated rotation support for KMS/HSM and TLS in Private Installer across Helm and Terraform. Includes Vault rewrap and SealedSecrets re-encryption workflows. See docs/operations/rotation.md for configuration and permissions.
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is backwards compatible. To enable rotation set values.rotation.enabled=true and provide kms/hsm config or use the supplied Terraform modules to provision keys. Rollback supported via private-installer rotation rollback; post-upgrade Helm hooks are guarded by health checks.
security_summary: Rotations performed without exporting plaintext keys; uses Vault rewrap and HSM PKCS#11 bindings. Audit logs emitted for key operations. Requires operator IAM permissions for KMS and Vault write access.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured TF modules could create wide IAM permissions. Mitigation: modules default to least-privilege policies in examples and docs include permissions matrix; CI includes terraform-validate and policy checks.
